newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.23 pct on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.23 pct on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.23 percent on dollar inflows to close at 1.0715 per dollar after volatile trade in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
At 1645 local/1945 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $75 million surplus Tuesday.
In the four previous trading days, the forex contracts accumulated a $240.8 million deficit. On Monday, the Central Bank sold dollars to supply market demand.
The local currency was traded between 1.0700 and 1.0737 reais per greenback, with players following the direction of dollar flows throughout the day, dealers said.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real dropped 0.07 percent to end at 1.0744 per dollar.
In the parallel market, the real closed steady at 1.130 per dollar, traders said.
